== Biography ==
=== Birmingham parent identification — 12 November 2026 ===
Select the existing record-defined Robert Glasgow of the Robert/Mary Birmingham family as Abraham’s probable father, 86%. The new 26 December 1803 St Martin baptism names Abraham Glassgow’s father Robert Glassgow and mother Mary. The 1851 index gives Abraham Glasgow, 47, born Birmingham, with wife Ely, 46, and children Joseph, 18, David, 12, Daniel, 5, and Sarah, 2. The known Abraham/Elizabeth baptisms include Joseph in September 1834, compatible with birth around 1833 and delayed baptism. In 1861 Abraham is still Birmingham-born, with Daniel, 16, and Sarah, 13. The continuing child group identifies the same adult family; the wife’s indexed short form is consistent with Elizabeth, not an independently proved new wife. The rare given name, local birthplace and approximate generation favour identifying this adult with the baptised child. The nearby 1806 St Martin David entry names Robert Glasgow and Mary, favouring the existing documentary parent account over creating another same-couple father. This is a newly proposed parent for an existing account, not a first rating of an unchanged known father.

Select the existing record-defined Mary of the Robert/Mary Birmingham family as Abraham’s probable mother, independently assessed at 86%. The 1803 baptism explicitly names Mary as the child’s mother, and the 1806 David baptism names Mary alongside the same Robert in the same parish. The adult Abraham is identified through the 1851/1861 family and Birmingham birthplace. The maternal identity depends on matching these Robert/Mary households, not merely on the common forename Mary. Her maiden surname remains unknown.

These are provider indexes, not newly read originals. The 1803 general and Warwickshire entries are copies of one event. Census ages imply about 1804 in 1851 and 1806 in 1861; the 1871 Birmingham-born machinist aged 70 is a compatible comparison only, not an independently proved identification. No exact birth date or death is adopted. The official original viewer for DGS007760346, image212, resolves to 3Q9M-CSMM-F3XG and explicitly displays Image Restricted; the manuscript was not read. Robert Glasgow-3220, buried in 1827, remains a compatible but unproved identity for the documentary father; David’s existing 45% link to that burial account and the older Abraham’s 15% father hypothesis are unchanged. The 86% values are subjective whole-profile judgments, retaining the adult-child and same-couple identity uncertainties. FamilySearch tree attachments are locators, not evidence.

== Research Notes ==
Identity review, 2026-11-04: catalogue people with the same given name and a Glasgow-surname variant were compared by dates, spouse, parents and place. Possible profile identities: fmp-glasgow-87e39356adbb Abraham Glasgow b. on or before 7 Apr 1786 (chronology fits); Glasgow-1235 Abraham Glasgow b. before 1745-08-18. None is clearly preferred on the indexed facts, so this entry is held for identity review. Ruled out: Glasgow-1227 Abraham Glasgow b. 1719-03-29: dates conflict: catalogue birth 1719-03-29 too early for a parent in 1842; chronology conflict: catalogue events are dated 1719-1719; Glasgow-750 Abraham Glasgow b. c. 1837 d. 1897: dates conflict: catalogue birth c. 1837 too late for a parent in 1842; place cannot fit: catalogue life recorded only outside the British Isles (Chester, Pennsylvania, United States); record-ancestry-glasgow-f0004f5ceab0 Abraham Glasgow b. c. 1729 d. 1818: dates conflict: catalogue birth c. 1729 too early for a parent in 1842; died 1818, before the 1842 parent.

Next research: Inspect the original register entry for fuller names, residences and relatives.
